coverage: 32 present-day Indian state/UT regions whose 2011 census totals can be mapped without splitting districts. Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh are deliberately not colored: 2011 source states predate their later splits. No coverage for neighbouring countries or below-state demographics.

omittedRegions.reason: 2011 Andhra Pradesh included Telangana; no present-boundary split is applied.
Telangana was part of Andhra Pradesh in 2011; no present-boundary split is applied.
2011 Jammu & Kashmir included Ladakh; no present-boundary split is applied.
Ladakh was part of Jammu & Kashmir in 2011; no present-boundary split is applied.

sources.title: Census of India 2011: Primary Census Abstract, India & States/UTs, state and district level
sources.note: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India. Total population TOT_P; urban share Urban TOT_P / Total TOT_P; age-7+ literacy P_LIT / (TOT_P - P_06). Percentages computed from final counts, rounded to two decimals.

sources.title: Census of India 2011: C-16, Population by mother tongue, India
sources.note: Individual mother-tongue rows (not language-group subtotals), state total persons. Six largest named mother tongues and a derived remainder. Includes terminal unclassified OTHERS in the remainder. Not official-language status or second-language proficiency.

sources.title: Census of India 2011: C-01, Population by religious community, India
sources.note: Eight Census categories including other religions and religion not stated; total persons. Religious identity is self-reported at Census.
